units.source_text: 我已经尝尽了吸量管器械之类的苦楚。

en.t: I have already tasted all the misery of pipettes and instruments and the like.

units.source_text: 想要孩子的话，赶紧发明体外受孕的方法，不就好了吗？

en.t: If people want children, would it not be enough to hurry up and invent a method of conception outside the body?

units.source_text: 倘若胚胎学家一方面梦想着发明让生出来的婴儿不带母亲的血统，

en.t: If an embryologist, on the one hand, dreams of inventing a way for a newborn baby to carry none of the mother's bloodline,

units.source_text: 而纯粹是父亲血统的孩子这样一种童贞生殖法，

en.t: but instead to be a child of purely the father's bloodline, a kind of virgin reproduction,

units.source_text: 另一方面自己终生无子而归西，那该多么美好！

en.t: and on the other hand dies without ever having a child himself, how splendid that would be!

units.source_text: 这样一来，才是与神灵挑战的人啊。”

en.t: Only then would he truly be a person who challenges the gods."
